engineApi.name: stations / stationsStatus
engineApi.description: Bundled CA tide station list (192 items: {id,n,la,lo}) loaded once from ./data/tide-stations-ca.json; status loading|ready|failed.

engineApi.name: panel

engineApi.name: initTides
engineApi.description: Fetch the station JSON once at boot (was tidesInit, app.js:521).

engineApi.name: loadTidesTimes
engineApi.description: Cache-first tide loader: cache key fishapp.tides.{id}, valid while it covers the future, network skipped if <24h old, offline shows cache or offline state, de-duped while in flight, a failed refresh never replaces a cache on screen. Also re-derives sun/moon/solunar. Called on panel open, by the 10-min online tick, and by Retry.

engineApi.description: (ll) â†’ nearest station using cos(lat)-scaled distance. Also used by First Mate get_tides and the area download.

engineApi.description: Pure: curve path/area/now-line/marks from hi/lo (cosine interpolation, 320x90, pad 4), and the 8 hi/lo rows starting one before the next future tide.

engineApi.name: sunTimes / moonTimes / moonIllumination / moonPhaseName / solunar
engineApi.description: Pure offline astronomy (SunCalc port) plus solunar periods (majors Â±60min at lunar transits, minors Â±45min at moonrise/set) for the device-local day.

engineApi.name: sunMoonSolunar / now

engineApi.name: panel

risks: LATENT BUG (needs a decision): catch.js:148 declares const nowMs inside a try block, but the tide block at 213-228 uses it. Verified ReferenceError, silently swallowed at catch.js:229, introduced by commit 0d79399. Since then no catch records tide/minsToTideChange/tidePct/tideRangeFt/tideStation, the bite engine's tide dimensions never train from new catches, and the modal hint claiming tide is captured is false. Porting verbatim keeps it broken; fixing it changes scoring, popup/list/card output and save duration.

Unescaped interpolation of c.photo (img src), c.length, c.weight and cond.* in the popup (catch.js:40-48) and list (303-305) allows HTML injection from a crafted backup import. React escaping fixes this; also validate that photo is a data:image URL.

Timezone assumption: NOAA lst_ldt times and Open-Meteo timezone=auto times are parsed as device-local. This only works when the phone is in the location's time zone. Keep it as-is; don't 'fix' to UTC.

localStorage quota: a tides.js:78 setItem failure overwrites a freshly rendered graph with the error box (when no cache was shown); a bite.js:290 failure returns stale or empty tides instead of the fetched ones. Per-station keys fishapp.tides.{id} are never pruned.
#tide-hilo is not cleared on loading, offline or error states, so a previous station's rows can appear under a new station name.
The solunar NOW/past highlight only refreshes on panel open or the 10-min tick, and that tick runs only when online, so offline it goes stale while the panel stays open.
Tide station list fetch failure (tidesInit swallows errors) gives a permanent 'No tide station data available.' with no Retry until reload; Tides.loaded is never read.
renderBiteWindows has no request token, so overlapping calls race; biteWindows fetches 11 days of NOAA tides before checking that a forecast exists.

captureConditions makes 3 sequential fetches under a 30s global timeout, so Save can show 'Savingâ€¦' for up to ~90s (4 fetches if the tide bug is fixed). If the user closes and reopens the modal mid-save, the in-flight save closes the new modal.
Photo pipeline has no error path (undecodable HEIC is silently dropped); saving before decode finishes saves without the photo; a stale decode can land in a newer modal session.

makeCatchCard: a cancelled share falls through to a download plus toast, and the unattached-anchor download may fail in WebViews. Verify Web Share with files and blob downloads inside the native iOS fishapp:// WKWebView shell.
biteCondAt Math.round(null) turns a missing hourly wind into 0 kn / 0Â°. Port verbatim or fix deliberately.
Performance: biteDayAstro and biteTimesMs memoisation must be kept or the panel open slows dramatically (169 hours Ã— solunar sweeps Ã— date parses).

Catch.all is replaced wholesale by spots.js import, so the React store needs a reloadCatchesFromDb action and marker rebuild. Stats grouping is case-sensitive and includes undefined species from imports.
Copy inconsistency: the empty list says 'tap ðŸŽ£ Log Catch' but the button says 'ðŸŽ£ Log a Catch'. Preserve the copy or align it deliberately.
topLevelSideEffects: None at script load: astro.js runs a pure IIFE (const Astro); tides.js/catch.js/bite.js only declare consts and functions. bite.js allocates _biteAstroCache (Map) and _biteTimeCache (WeakMap).

Intervals are owned by app.js: 10-min loadTidesTimes when panel-tides is open, online and visible (app.js:497-506); 10-min watchCheck (app.js:510).
